brief.headline: Push for a 10–15% price cut toward ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps, backed by market fair-value and credible listed alternates, while keeping 30-day terms.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a 10–15% reduction on rigid plastic packaging, targeting ₹0.65–0.80/pc for caps at higher volume.
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser specs — the market verdict is 'MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec'.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold current 30-day terms; no reason to extend given their private status and our lack of visibility into their finances.

brief.financialLeverage: Suraj Blow Plast publishes no financials, so we have no view on their health or cash position. Our ₹58.17 L annual spend is material to a private packaging converter, giving us standing to ask for better pricing. The ask is grounded in open-market data showing room to ₹0.65–0.80/pc, not on squeezing a distressed supplier. We have five strong alternates — three listed firms and two large privates — so we can credibly qualify a second source if they won't move on price.

evidence.point: We spend ₹58.17 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging.
Market asking price for 28 mm PP caps runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc.
At higher volume or looser spec, the market shows headroom down to ₹0.65–0.80/pc.
Keeping 30-day terms frees up ₹4.78 L of our cash each year.
HDPE resin import unit value stands at 87.61 ₹/kg, giving us a raw-material benchmark.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms — with revenue of ₹2569.83 Cr and a health score of B (65/100); top second-source candidate.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader in pails, containers and pharma packaging — strong and profitable, a robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd
alternates.why: Listed PET bottle and jar specialist (Pearlpet brand) — direct fit for PET bottles if we need to diversify.

risks: Their financials aren't public, so we can't see if they're cash-tight or over-leveraged — watch for any sign they're struggling to deliver on time.
Pushing too hard without a qualified second source lined up could leave us scrambling if they walk away or cut us off.
The market headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc depends on higher volume or looser specs — confirm our order size and spec tolerance before locking the target.
Alternates like Manjushree and Mold-Tek are much larger; onboarding them may require longer lead times and minimum-order commitments we need to plan for.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, and with our ₹58.17 L annual spend and the market showing caps at ₹0.65–0.80 for volume orders, we'd like to close the gap and lock in a 10–15% reduction this quarter.
